courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 明石海峽大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨」與「風洞試驗的相似性與雷諾數效應」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；明石海峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Main span, sag ratio and tower height" and "Similarity and Reynolds effects in wind-tunnel tests" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Akashi Kaikyo Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦首座主跨超過 2,000 m 的懸索橋：垂跨比、1,960 MPa 鋼絲、隔震式沉箱基礎與雙箱梁抗風；明石海峽大橋則以以數字深入明石海峽大橋：顫振裕度、高強度鋼絲、設置沉箱、地震後幾何修正與主纜乾燥空氣為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first suspension span beyond 2,000 m: sag ratio, 1,960 MPa wire, isolated caisson foundations and twin-box wind resistance; Akashi Kaikyo Bridge centres on numbers behind Akashi Kaikyo: flutter margin, high-strength wire, laid-down caissons, post-quake geometry correction and dry-air cables, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「垂跨比與 318 m 塔高」與「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到明石海峽大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Sag ratio and 318 m towers” and “Truss flutter margin”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 里翁—安提里翁大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨」與「風洞試驗的相似性與雷諾數效應」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；里翁—安提里翁大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Main span, sag ratio and tower height" and "Similarity and Reynolds effects in wind-tunnel tests" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Rion–Antirion Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦首座主跨超過 2,000 m 的懸索橋：垂跨比、1,960 MPa 鋼絲、隔震式沉箱基礎與雙箱梁抗風；里翁—安提里翁大橋則以在 65 m 深海、軟弱沉積層與活動斷層上，以可滑移基礎與連續全懸吊橋面化解地震與構造位移為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first suspension span beyond 2,000 m: sag ratio, 1,960 MPa wire, isolated caisson foundations and twin-box wind resistance; Rion–Antirion Bridge centres on sliding foundations and a continuous fully suspended deck that absorb earthquakes and tectonic movement in 65 m of water on soft sediments, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「垂跨比與 318 m 塔高」與「墩間相對位移」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到里翁—安提里翁大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Sag ratio and 318 m towers” and “Relative pier movement”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rion–Antirion Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 1915 恰納卡萊大橋
history.text: 土耳其公路總局把達達尼爾海峽跨越列為馬爾馬拉高速公路環線的關鍵段，2017 年 3 月 18 日動土，由 DL E&C、Limak、SK ecoplant 與 Yapı Merkezi 組成的聯合體承建，COWI 負責細部設計，Arup 與 Aas-Jakobsen 等擔任獨立驗證。工程以 1,960 MPa 級鋼絲、318 m 鋼塔與乾塢預製沉箱完成，2022 年 3 月 18 日通車，以 2,023 m 超越明石海峽大橋成為世界最長跨徑懸索橋，也是第一座主跨超過 2 km 的懸索橋。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Türkiye's General Directorate of Highways made the Dardanelles crossing the key link of the Marmara motorway ring; ground was broken on 18 March 2017, with a consortium of DL E&C, Limak, SK ecoplant and Yapı Merkezi as contractor, COWI as detailed designer, and Arup and Aas-Jakobsen among the independent checkers. Built with 1,960 MPa class wire, 318 m steel towers and caissons cast in dry dock, it opened on 18 March 2022, overtaking Akashi Kaikyo with a 2,023 m span to become the world's longest suspension span and the first beyond 2 km. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
